scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.audit: npm audit && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix backend && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix frontend
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run test:contrast && npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit
